evidence: Smallest-submission test (quality-checks.md #7). (1) Greenfield: environment/Dockerfile creates /app containing only .gitkeep ('touch /app/.gitkeep ... git commit -m "Initialize task workspace"'), so no trivial tweak of an existing app is possible; the agent must build the whole server, SQLite schema, one-time seed import and UI. (2) The brief asks for a multi-user, server-backed product, not a static page or one CRUD screen: instruction.md asks for 'a secure chat where each client talks to us inside their legal matter ... in proper threads', with ethical walls 'from any corner of the app' and retention/legal hold; integration.md fixes Node 22 /app/server.js on 0.0.0.0:3000, SQLite at /app/app.db or DB_PATH, /api/health, import once and survive restarts, fixed clock; walls-and-retention.md and conversations.md add server-side wall enforcement on every route, timers with permanent deletion, holds, edits with versions and stale-edit refusal, safe formatting, message links, mentions, per-user unread, idempotent sends, live updates within ~5 s, transcripts and search. The golden itself is ~1,345 lines (server.js 519, app.js 572, plus HTML/CSS). (3) Grading separates a stub from a build: render gate 'authenticated_render' fails a 'blank page, static mock, generic error' and requires nothing private before sign-in, wrong-password rejection and Gwen's populated matters; constraints gate 'server_backed_local_application' requires posting 'Gate check JUDGE-G1' as Gwen, surviving reload, and being visible to Harriet in a separate browser context ('A message that never saves, or that only the posting browser can see, fails this gate'), which excludes localStorage/static mocks per REVIEW_POLICY 'Gates must exclude convincing dead apps'. score.py:41-48 zeroes reward unless both gates pass and functional > 0.05 floor. Functional has 16 binary criteria (total weight 33) covering walls, retention, holds, edits, threads, live updates, persistence across restart_app. Weak-app probe: a static/mock page or client-only chat fails the constraints gate -> reward 0. A plausible broken-but-real app (basic Express+SQLite chat with sign-in and client scoping but no walls/threads/timers/holds) passes gates and can clear the functional floor with signin_and_client_scope alone (2/33 = 0.061 > 0.05), plausibly earning roughly 0.2 overall from polish/visual partials; this is not a stub (it is already a real server-backed, authorised, persistent multi-user app) and the floor is the template-controlled value (template tests/scoring.toml identical), so it is not a row-7 defect; reward calibration belongs to the reward-soundness rows. Conforming-alternative probe: any real implementation (SSE vs polling, any route names, any UI) passes the gates because they grade observable post/reload/second-context readback and never prescribe endpoints (constraints prompt.md:12 'Do not prescribe endpoint names or implementation structure'); no conforming app is excluded by the real-product requirement. Risk=true only because the stub-exclusion claim rests on unmeasured configured-judge behaviour: raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent', and the scripted golden run (golden-run.log: gate_constraints PASS ... exit 0) exercised the golden only, not a stub or weak app, and did not cover the render gate. No source defect found for this row.
